value.rationale: The natural deterministic traffic relaxation question is complete at each density, including a sharp finite-sector transient bound, an exact labeled state-count n Catalan_{m-1}, and a structural uniqueness theorem characterizing maximally slow jams. Unlike general convergence and typical-scale papers, it resolves the extremal tail exactly for every ring length; it is not a routine small finite table or a renaming of the local ballot result.
